content.text: [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-products-without-stripe-which-architecture-actually-22|selling]] a digital product should be a simple transaction. You build something valuable — an ebook, a course, a Notion template, a font family, a preset pack, a beat — and someone pays you for access to it. The file transfers. The transaction completes. But for millions of creators, the payment layer is where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-how-creators-ghana-3|COREMERCH guide to everything]]-about-solana-payments-digital-products-guide-leaves-5|Everything About]] breaks down. Stripe is unavailable. PayPal flags the account. Gumroad holds the payout. The workarounds stop working. What actually works is a sovereign commerce stack: a static storefront on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, automatic payment verification through NOWPayments, and delivery triggered by a webhook the moment the transaction confirms on-chain. No platform intermediary. No payout schedule. No geography filter. The customer owns the storefront code, the order history, the customer list, and the product files. COREMERCH has no access after deployment.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-every-detail-you-3. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

A sovereign digital commerce stack is a combination of free and paid tools that enable digital creators to set up a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. This infrastructure is crucial for creators who sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software, as it allows them to monetize their digital products without relying on restrictive payment platforms.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a sovereign digital commerce stack typically involves a hosting solution like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, a backend logic tool like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, an order storage system like Supabase or Google Sheets, and a file delivery mechanism like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. NOWPayments, a crypto payment gateway, is integrated to facilitate automatic on-chain payment verification with a 0.5% fee, significantly lower than the 10% charged by platforms like Gumroad.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed for digital creators in regions where traditional payment platforms are unavailable or severely restricted, such as Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, and the Philippines. By leveraging a sovereign digital commerce stack, these creators can bypass platform restrictions and monetize their digital products without incurring exorbitant fees or losing control over their data and customer relationships.
Sovereign digital commerce stacks provide creators with full data ownership and control over their customer relationships.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components of a sovereign digital commerce stack work in tandem to provide a seamless selling experience for digital creators. For instance, NOWPayments enables automatic crypto payment processing, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic and order fulfillment. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 facilitate instant file delivery. This integrated approach ensures that creators can focus on producing high-quality digital products while leaving the technical infrastructure to the stack.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, creators can start by selecting the components that best fit their needs. They can choose from a range of hosting, backend logic, order storage, and file delivery solutions, and integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), creators can access all the necessary blueprints and templates to build, deploy, and scale their sovereign digital commerce stack, including instant download and lifetime access to the resources.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, creators can leverage a sovereign digital commerce stack that integrates crypto payments. By using a hosting solution like GitHub Pages, a backend logic tool like Cloudflare Workers, and a crypto payment gateway like NOWPayments, creators can set up a fully operational online store and start selling their digital products without relying on restrictive payment platforms. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference between NOWPayments (0.5%) and Gumroad (10%) retains $921, making it a more cost-effective solution for creators.
NOWPayments facilitates crypto payment processing with a 0.5% fee, significantly lower than traditional payment platforms.
